title: Shinonome Akito — Unyielding Resolve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's definitely cracked...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We still don't know why it formed so easily. I mean, there's no way a wall this big could be that brittle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well... I guess there's no use in dwelling on this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha!
You could only juggle it eight times!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are they doing...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
B-Because it hit my toe!
I juggled it a hundred times this one time easy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, try doing it again!
We can have a contest to see who can juggle it for longer!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're on!
Don't forget that my personal best is better than yours!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, how long do you two plan on playing with that ball?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? As long as we're having fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We decided to take a little break after all that walking we did!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A break...? But it looks like you're playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're tired of walking, not of playing soccer!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, Akito, since you're here, you should join our juggling contest!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Why me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, join us!
How many times can you juggle one of these?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How many times? Not sure...
I remember doing about 500 once, but I've never really kept track.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: F-Five hundred?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Relax... You're basically just rinsing and repeating once you've learned how to control it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Len, didn't you just say that you did a hundred one time? You also seem to be getting the hang of it, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At this rate, you'll both be able to keep it in the air for as long as you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What?!
You're saying that we can get better?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, if you practice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess I can stick around for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pass me the ball.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once you know how to juggle like it's second nature, you guys can try doing something a little more challenging.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For example, this drill.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You kick the ball against a wall, juggle it a couple times and kick it at the wall again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The goal is to trap the ball, get control of it and kick it back gently using only your feet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That looks really hard...!
How are you able to make it float like that...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Practice and experience?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
If you're alone, a wall works...
But since you're partners, why don't you try kicking it to each other?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: To each other...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Soccer's a team sport, so it's always better to practice with people when you can.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, Rin!
That looked really hard, but let's give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay! Lemme take a few steps back first...
Len, you stay there!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, here it goes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, trap it and...
Wait, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why'd you kick it over there, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, but this is so hard!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was also partly your fault, Len.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're both working as a team, so you need to make it easy on your partner to get control of the ball.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
Sorry, Rin! Lemme try that again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! I'll get it right this time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I was just like them when I first started playing soccer...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was so happy whenever I managed to juggle the ball for a while or managed to get a clean pass off to my teammate.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Len and Rin know each other really well, so I'm sure they'll quickly figure out a way to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The same thing goes for singing... Compared to when you're alone, it's so much easier to get better when you're with people who run at the same pace as you.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Maybe we'll get to do more drills and games like this before long.)

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Oh no! I'm sorry!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, maybe not that soon.
